plugins.description: Paid media strategy, analysis, and measurement via BlueAlpha's unified MCP: Google, Meta, TikTok, LinkedIn and Snapchat Ads, and Meridian MMM. 63 skills for account audits, creative refresh, audience intelligence, incrementality testing, geo expansion, budget reallocation, attribution reconciliation, and full Meta/TikTok/LinkedIn audit suites.
